identity.title: [v0.92.1][runtime-v3] Archive Runtime logs to S3 on a bounded schedule

values.review_scope: Exact #594 Runtime observability, Vector, Terraform archive, focused tests, and issue-local evidence paths only.
review_prompts: Can any S3 or Vector failure block Runtime readiness, operation, or recovery?
Are buffer, retry, disk, and telemetry bounds explicit and tested?
Are object identity and payloads redacted and portable?
Are bucket and IAM controls least privilege and Terraform-owned?
